title: Residue-field inverses for finite-field constructible pullback
statement: Fix the finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite-type $k$-scheme $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For each $y\in Y$, define the residue-field inverse structure to be the unique inverse of $\ell\in\kappa(y)$. In the recorded constructible-truncation interface [prop-constructible-truncations], these structures are extracted from its residue-invertibility component, with algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell=\operatorname{AlgebraicClosure}(\mathbf Q_\ell)$. Inverse structures are subsingletons, so this extraction specifies the same inverse as the finite-field characteristic calculation and adds no choice of a different coefficient object.
